## Description

 I am experiencing an issue regarding my friends list saying that everyone is offline. It does not show me how long they've been offline until I click on their account and After I exit their profile it still says that they're off. I've also noticed that whenever a friend of mine gets it says that they're off line even though they're online. It's a little bit hard to describe what this bug is about but it seems to be an issue with the recent update regarding the UI change.

## Reproduction Steps

 There's no real fix unless you get out of the beta
